hook.en: A Byzantine mile marker is Istanbul’s point of departure.
hook.tr: Bizans’ın mil taşı, İstanbul’un başlangıç noktası.

hook.en: Chora’s church and Kariye’s mosque occupy the same building.
hook.tr: Hora Kilisesi ile Kariye Camii aynı yapının iki adı.

hook.en: Church, museum, mosque: three uses in one building.
hook.tr: Kilise, müze, cami: tek yapının üç farklı kullanımı.

dolmabahce-mosque.note: Wikidata P131 is Beyoğlu (Q217411); mosque and palace are on different sides of the district boundary.

asiyan.note: Aşiyan Museum is in Bebek, Beşiktaş; it is not in Sarıyer.

hisart.note: Wikidata describes Şişli; OSM places the supplied P625 point in Hürriyet Mahallesi, Kağıthane. The district follows OSM; P30 must field-check the institution’s address.

land-walls.note: One Q89917 layered record for land and sea walls. Point is a representative location, not an entrance or the whole wall geometry.

silivri-gate.note: Wikidata identifies the named quarter. P15 must place the gate stop with a separate surveyed entrance; the quarter point is not a gate entrance.

hook.en: Silivrikapı names a quarter beside the land walls.
hook.tr: Silivrikapı, kara surlarının yanındaki semte adını veriyor.

mevlana-gate.note: Wikidata identifies the named quarter. P15 must place the gate stop with a separate surveyed entrance; the quarter point is not a gate entrance.

hook.en: Mevlanakapı names a quarter beside the land walls.
hook.tr: Mevlanakapı, kara surlarının yanındaki semte adını veriyor.

topkapi-gate.note: Wikidata identifies the named quarter. P15 must place the gate stop with a separate surveyed entrance; the quarter point is not a gate entrance.

hook.en: Topkapı quarter names a quarter beside the land walls.
hook.tr: Topkapı semti, kara surlarının yanındaki semte adını veriyor.

edirnekapi.note: Fatih quarter Q140042770 selected over Q647228, whose point falls in Eyüpsultan. Quarter point is not the gate entrance; P15 must survey the gate stop.

hook.en: Edirnekapı names a quarter beside the land walls.
hook.tr: Edirnekapı, kara surlarının yanındaki semte adını veriyor.

kerkoporta.note: OSM tourism=artwork marker labelled Kerkoporta, not evidence of the historical gate location. Location disputed; P15 must review.

hook.en: A marker names the Kerkoporta; the historical gate’s location is disputed.
hook.tr: Bir işaret Kerkoporta adını taşıyor; tarihî kapının yeri tartışmalı.

anastasian-wall.note: OSM places this Wikidata representative point in Akören, Silivri. The linear monument also crosses Çatalca; P16/P32 need segment geometry, not duplicate place identities.

belgrade-gate.note: OSM places the Wikidata gate point on the Kazlıçeşme, Zeytinburnu side of the wall. Entrance not surveyed.

bosphorus.note: Waterway spanning multiple districts; Sarıyer is the chapter anchor. Wikidata P625 is an indicative strait point, not a visitor entrance; OSM reverse over water falls back to Istanbul city, not a district. P32 must use shore access points.

galata-bridge.note: Bridge joins Fatih and Beyoğlu; Beyoğlu is the northern chapter anchor. Wikidata P625 marks the bridge, not an entrance; P20 must survey the lens viewpoint.

golden-horn.note: Waterway spanning districts; Fatih is the chapter anchor. The representative water point is not a visitor entrance.

basilica-cistern.note: OSM historic=cistern point preferred to the Wikidata point just west of Milion. This is a mapped site point; visitor entrance remains unverified.

hook.en: A Byzantine water reservoir beneath Sultanahmet.
hook.tr: Sultanahmet’in altında bir Bizans su deposu.

hook.en: Via Egnatia: a Roman road west of Constantinople.
hook.tr: Egnatia Yolu: Konstantinopolis’in batısına uzanan Roma yolu.

via-egnatia.note: Representative OSM relation bounding-box centre, not a road access point. This linear road crosses several countries; P13 must author the actual route geometry.

hook.en: Galata’s walls belong to the Genoese city across the Golden Horn.
hook.tr: Galata surları, Haliç’in karşı kıyısındaki Ceneviz yerleşimini çevreliyordu.
